question: Is there a meaningful new empirical ALL-model venetoclax comparison beyond exact published native EMC claims?

prior_claim_boundary.monotherapy: Initial moderate screen response did not validate in the two native USZ models; negative validation already reported.
prior_claim_boundary.combination: Published Figure6 compares venetoclax+carfilzomib and doxorubicin+carfilzomib in USZ20/USZ22 and already reports model-specific synergy/additivity. Discussion instead names venetoclax+doxorubicin.
prior_claim_boundary.NCC: Published221 screen includes venetoclax; selected24 IC50 panel omits it. Neither omission nor label proves nonresponse or a matched validation curve.

could_have_value: An actual independently controlled native venetoclax single-agent or precisely identified combination response, under a compatible exposure/readout or explicitly justified assay-separated comparison, could challenge reproducibility and determine a controlled replication. Gene or IHC positivity is neither sufficient nor universally required for that empirical drug-response question.
why_existing_label_comparison_is_not_eno: NCC screen exposure, time and control compatibility must be substantiated; dose-response subset excludes venetoclax, so a common IC50 cannot be inferred.
USZ two-model monotherapy failure and combination-specific differences are already reported and evaluated; reproducing their qualitative claims is not a new biological finding.
Source-text pairing discrepancy cannot create a venetoclax+doxorubicin experiment.
A published curve may remain suitable for verification, but selecting a new synergy estimator/cutoff to manufacture a claim is not justified.
Broader generic model/source conditions remain pending; three known contexts do not establish all-public completion.
alternatives: ATP metabolic viability versus another primary screening readout
Selection of drugs and dose-response curves after screening
Drug formulation/chemical name fidelity and technical replicate structure
Culture selection/adaptation and donor-level heterogeneity rather than BCL2-specific dependency
defeat: No exact useful unanswered source-compatible comparison, or the same qualitative result is already published/evaluated, warrants stopping this scoped candidate before new drug values.
not_inferred: Clinical benefit or clinically effective exposure
No venetoclax response in NCC from selected-panel absence
Genotype-agnostic response from one model per partner
numerical_stage: OFF: actual measured pair identity is resolved, but no consequential new all-model quantitative claim justified; no drug response analysis authorized.
